dispositions.name: gnupg2
dispositions.reason: The upstream condition is Windows ProgramData DACL inheritance. This exact immutable image is Linux amd64, not GnuPG for Windows. Native severity and the separate real GnuPG issues are retained.
dispositions.limits: Only this exact advisory, source-package version and Linux image. Other GnuPG input/archive defects, Windows images, external executables and host compromise are not covered.

dispositions.name: systemd
dispositions.reason: The defect requires systemd-journald ForwardToWall processing. This immutable broker image contains libsystemd0/libudev1 but not the journald daemon or systemd runtime directory; the inspected absent paths and exact image are mandatory conditions, not a claim that all systemd code is safe.
dispositions.limits: No installed or externally mounted journald daemon, alternate init or arbitrary host execution. A present or unproved path rejects the disposition. Upstream still defers the version fix.

webappNginxRequirement.reason: The exact webapp has upstream nginx 1.31.1. Native Alpine scanning omitted version-applicable publisher advisories. Without exact feature/config dispositions these remain blocked, even when its library-only patch has zero native findings. This gate does not authorize changing nginx or the original default topology.

postgresVendorRequirement.reason: PGDG packages are not covered by the same Debian OSV source-package advisory mapping. No native finding for postgresql-18 is not proof of an up-to-date PostgreSQL server. Same-major security updates need no dump/restore, but old data or configuration migration is not authorized here.

dispositions.name: glibc
dispositions.reason: The affected strncasecmp implementation is the Power8 optimization. This immutable candidate is Linux amd64, not Power8; this is a platform exclusion, not a fixed-version claim.
dispositions.limits: Only this immutable amd64 image and advisory. Other glibc APIs and architectures are not reviewed.

dispositions.name: glibc
dispositions.reason: The vulnerable DNS cache thread belongs to nscd, absent from the image. Ordinary PostgreSQL libc DNS calls do not instantiate this daemon.
dispositions.limits: Fresh absent-path proof is required. External daemon mounts and alternate runtimes are outside this decision.

dispositions.name: libxml2
dispositions.reason: The affected usershell input handling is in the xmlcatalog command in shell mode, not every libxml2 call. This CLI is absent from the exact image.
dispositions.limits: Only this absent CLI condition; PostgreSQL XML and other libxml2 findings remain unreviewed.

dispositions.name: systemd
dispositions.reason: ForwardToWall requires systemd-journald, which is absent. Installing libsystemd does not run journald or forward emergency messages to terminals.
dispositions.limits: Only the absent journald service; no blanket exclusion for libsystemd consumers.

dispositions.name: systemd
dispositions.reason: The vulnerable group-membership update is in systemd-homed, absent from this PostgreSQL image. No account files are inspected.
dispositions.limits: Only the absent homed service, not general user management or other systemd findings.

dispositions.name: apt
dispositions.reason: The advisory concerns apt-key net-update master-keyring verification, not all APT download paths. Both Debian apt-key executable paths are absent from this exact APT3.0.4 image; current package contents also omit the tool. The source-package vulnerable label is retained, not recast as a fixed version.
dispositions.limits: Only this exact absent apt-key condition and version. Other APT advisories, alternate images and externally supplied executables remain outside this disposition.

dispositions.name: systemd
dispositions.reason: The affected IPC API is implemented by the separate systemd-oomd daemon, absent at both checked executable paths. Installing libsystemd/libudev does not expose that daemon's process-termination API.
dispositions.limits: Only the absent oomd daemon on this immutable image. Shared journal APIs, SELinux permission handling and other systemd findings remain unreviewed and blocking.

dispositions.name: sqlite3
dispositions.reason: This advisory requires the SQLite command-line shell .recover output to be piped into sqlite3. Neither installed shell path exists in this immutable image; libsqlite3 alone does not provide the shell command.
dispositions.limits: Only this absent CLI condition. gpg and liblastlog2 load libsqlite3, so other SQLite API findings remain unreviewed and blocking.

dispositions.name: sqlite3
dispositions.reason: Debian confirms that the vulnerable SQLAR code was never present in a released Debian version. The upstream change switched sqlarUncompressFunc from sqlite3_value_int to sqlite3_value_int64 in a March 2026 development snapshot and was corrected before release; this exact Debian3.46.1 build predates it. This is not a backported-fix or whole-library claim.
dispositions.limits: Only this exact package ecosystem/version and immutable candidate. Other SQLite SQLAR snapshots or API advisories remain unreviewed.

dispositions.name: sqlite3
dispositions.reason: The affected zipfileInflate belongs to the zipfile extension, not the SQLite core shared library. Debian explicitly does not build that extension for its binary packages. The exact installed libsqlite3-0 manifest contains the core library and documentation only; both standard shipped extension paths are absent on the immutable candidate.
dispositions.limits: Fresh absent-extension facts are required. Externally mounted or custom-built extensions are not covered; other SQLite API findings remain blocking, and the source-package version is not claimed fixed.

dispositions.name: util-linux
dispositions.reason: Debian disables the affected util-linux chfn/chsh build. On the exact immutable candidate both shipped programs are owned by passwd from src:shadow, not by util-linux; fresh provider facts are mandatory.
dispositions.limits: Only this exact native util-linux mapping and advisory. No waiver for login, mount, nsenter, shadow findings or another image/provider. The source version is not claimed patched.

dispositions.name: bzip2
dispositions.reason: Debian identifies the flaw in the standalone bzip2recover utility, not ordinary libbz2 decompression. Both canonical executable paths are absent on this immutable image; fresh missing-path facts are required.
dispositions.limits: Only the absent recovery utility and this exact advisory/package/image. The bzip2 source version remains marked vulnerable upstream; libbz2 and other findings are not waived.

dispositions.name: gnupg2
dispositions.reason: The flaw requires tpm2daemon processing a PKDECRYPT command for a TPM-backed key. Debian ships that daemon as an independent component; neither canonical gnupg nor gnupg2 daemon path exists on this immutable image. Other GnuPG tools and libraries are not claimed absent.
dispositions.limits: Only the absent TPM daemon with fresh fixed-image path facts. OpenPGP signature/key parsing, gpgtar and CMS findings remain blocking; the source version is not declared fixed.

dispositions.name: gnupg2
dispositions.reason: This native binary mapping is the same installed source package with the separate tpm2daemon component absent at both canonical paths. The specific defect requires that daemon's PKDECRYPT processing, not general GnuPG library use.
dispositions.limits: Only this exact mapping and absent TPM daemon; other GnuPG findings remain blocking and no version-level fix is claimed.

dispositions.name: golang.org/x/sys
dispositions.reason: NewNTUnicodeString is in golang.org/x/sys/windows. The immutable candidate is Linux amd64; the retained x/sys version is not described as patched.
dispositions.limits: Only this Windows-specific advisory; all other Go findings remain blocking.
